spec.title: Brill loop on fly
spec.aria: A downward flow from fly counts NN 7 and VB 3 to baseline NN with P 0.70, then find 8 errors, best rule fixing 3 and breaking 1, apply rule with net gain 2, reaching 88.0 percent correct from 84.0 percent, with a dashed edge back to find errors to repeat.
